paper_title: First results of the CAST-RADES haloscope search for axions at 34.67 $μ$eV
notes: First CAST-RADES haloscope results at 34.67 ueV (8.384 GHz). Exclusion limit g_agamma >~ 4e-13 GeV^-1 at 95% credibility level over 34.6738 ueV < m_a < 34.6771 ueV, encoded as a flat two-point bound over the stated narrow mass range. Assumes local DM density rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and standard isothermal halo (Maxwell-Boltzmann) lineshape.
